supersession_reason: The 512- and 1024-token calibration ceilings truncated 20/20 clean controls. Before any 2048/4096 acquisition and before holdout access, the user selected the provider's official 16384-token high-reasoning example as one non-timid calibration ceiling.
scientific_target: Anticipation of externally verified code failure independently of provider generation-cap truncation.

generation_budget_calibration.candidate_order_rule: Run exactly one complete calibration-only candidate at 16384 tokens.
generation_budget_calibration.failure_rule: If 16384 does not meet the threshold, do not freeze or run the holdout; revise prospectively.

calibration_acquisition_control.resume_policy: Reuse validated completed raw.json files and acquire only missing sessions.
calibration_acquisition_control.reason: A high output ceiling requires enough wall-clock allowance to terminate naturally; one explicit attempt avoids duplicate long generations and manual --resume handles missing sessions.

primary_early_warning_analysis.horizon_selection_rule: Choose one operational latency target before freeze without inspecting holdout outcomes.

freeze_requirements: Bind the resulting selection artifact SHA-256.
Set exactly one primary absolute window horizon.
Bind dataset, calibration, runner, verifier, projector, evaluator and PRAMA kernel hashes.
Freeze cluster-aware inference, Monte Carlo seeds/draws/fallbacks and minimum effect of interest.
Verify no holdout outcome was accessed during model, budget or horizon selection.
